responsibility: This file contains H8/300 peephole2 optimizations that rewrite short RTL instruction sequences into smaller or more target-friendly forms after register allocation context is known. Its patterns cover masked shifts, push/stm packing, constant-plus-register reshaping, narrower loads before masking, stack-adjustment-plus-store folding, unary memory-op fusion on H8SX, and move-chain collapsing, making it the backend’s late local optimization layer rather than the primary instruction recognizer.
